cs.marges_larges_reponse_plus_lente: Wide margins: slower response, better tolerance of model errors and process variations.
cs.marges_nominales_non_calculees_reglag: Nominal margins not calculated (tuning saved before their introduction).
cs.matrice_combinee_enregistree_avec_l: Combined matrix saved with the measurement envelope and its nominal simulation.
cs.mesure_et_consigne_bleu_lambda: Measurement and setpoint ({0}): blue = Lambda, orange = SIMC, dotted green = setpoint. Controls ({1}): dotted = calculated control, green = applied control, grey = limits; violet = disturbance instant.
cs.mesure_non_stable_avant_lechelon: Measurement not stable before the step within its tolerance.
cs.mesure_s_manquee_s_sont: {0} missed sample(s) are recorded as gaps, without interpolation.
cs.mesures_manquee_s_segment_s: {0:N0} / {1:N0} samples · {2} missed · {3} segment(s) saved · elapsed {4} · estimated remaining {5}
cs.mesures_sur_en_segment_s: {0:N0} samples over {1} in {2} segment(s) of about {3} KiB, recorded as soon as they are complete. The overlap keeps a step near a gap whole if it lasts less than {4:G3} s: for a longer test, use the single acquisition. Carry out the control output steps with the controller in manual; ORIAS will then find them again in the history.
cs.modele_accepte_a_la_validation: Model accepted at the independent validation (test distinct from the estimation).
cs.modele_arx_oe_1_1: ARX / OE model (1,1) · K = {0:G5} {1}/{2} · τ = {3:G5} s · cautious θ = {4:G5} s (quantised to the {5:G3} s step)
cs.modele_arx_oe_sans_equivalent: ARX / OE model without a first-order equivalent
cs.modele_du_premier_ordre_le: first-order model: the PI is the SIMC rule.
cs.modele_exploratoire_a_confirmer_sur: exploratory model: to be confirmed on the installation.
cs.modele_fopdt_gain_k_s: FOPDT model {0} · gain K {1:G6} {2}/{3} · τ {4:G6} s · θ {5:G6} s · h {6:G6} s · horizon {7:G6} s. The reference is the saved Lambda PI tuning, recalculated on the same scenario.
cs.modele_non_accepte_aucun_reglage: Model not accepted: no tuning or simulation is deduced from it.
cs.modele_pente_k_s_par: Model: slope k′ = {0:G6} {1}/s per {2}, delay θ = {3:G6} s.
cs.modele_propose_les_deux_modeles: Proposed model: {0}. Both models meet the criteria, but the second order predicts the validation test significantly better (squared-error ratio {1:G3} > {2:G3}, level {3:P0}).
cs.modele_propose_ordre_le_plus: Proposed model: {0}, lowest order meeting the criteria.
cs.moins_de_12_mesures_avant: Fewer than 12 samples before the next control output change or missing data.
cs.moins_de_4_mesures_stables: Fewer than 4 stable samples before the step (moving measurement, data gap or previous step).
cs.moteur_indisponible_verifiez_linstall: Engine unavailable. Check the installation of Python and MKR_PYTHON.
cs.moteur_pid_kp_ti_s: Engine {0} · PID {1} · Kp {2:G6}, Ti {3:G6} s, Td {4:G6} s, Tf {5:G6} s. Results calculated on the same process and the same scenario; no tuning is saved or transferred.
cs.non_stabilisee_essai_trop_court: {0:G4} {1}, not settled: test too short or integrating process
cs.operation_impossible_verifiez_le_stoc: Operation impossible. Check the local storage, the file and the availability of Python.
cs.orias_valeurs_des_blocs_pid: ORIAS — Values of the PID_INT and PID_Compact blocks (not qualified)
cs.orias_valeurs_du_bloc_pidff: ORIAS — Values of the PIDFF block (not qualified)
cs.parametres_rejetes_kp_doit_avoir: Parameters rejected: Kp must have the sign of the process, Ti > 0, Td ≥ 0, Tf ≥ 0 and Tf > 0 if Td > 0.
cs.pas_assez_d_echantillons_pour: Not enough samples to estimate an ARX / OE model.
cs.pas_d_echantillonnage_irregulier_mkr: Irregular sampling step: ORIAS never interpolates measurements. Resample the recording at a fixed step at the source.
cs.pas_superieur_au_dixieme_de: Step larger than a tenth of the time constant. Check the sensitivity to the step.
cs.performances_calculees_sur_le_procede: performance calculated on the nominal process, without actuator limit or speed: to confirm with the full simulation scenario.
cs.performances_nominales_simulees_echel: Simulated nominal performance (unit step, no actuator limit; IAE = integral of the absolute error):
cs.periode_trop_courte_selectionnez_au: Period too short: select at least two displayed points.
cs.pid_optimise_sous_la_meme: PID optimised under the same constraint (search over Td/Ti ∈ {0.05 … 0.25} and Ti; the PID is never presumed better than the PI):
cs.plage_ab_choisie_de_s: · A–B range chosen: from {0:G4} s to {1:G4} s (indicators recalculated on this range, without a new estimation).
cs.plage_retenue_verifiez_les_conditions: Range retained. Check the test conditions and confirm them before the estimation.
cs.port_periode_nombre_de_mesures: Port, period, number of samples or tolerated gap invalid.
cs.rack_emplacement_ou_numero_de: Rack, slot or DB number invalid.
cs.rampe_ou_changement_de_la: Ramp or change of the control output over several samples: not a step.
cs.reglage_guide_objectif_de_robustesse: Guided tuning: robustness objective, comparison, curves
cs.reglage_impossible_l_etude_arx: Tuning impossible: the ARX study was refused at the independent validation. No tuning is deduced from it.
cs.reglage_impossible_le_modele_arx: Tuning impossible: the retained ARX model is second order; ORIAS does not yet document a reduction to first order to tune it. No tuning is invented.
cs.reglage_optimise_pour_le_rejet: Tuning optimised for disturbance rejection (maximum integral gain under the same robustness constraint):
cs.reglage_pi_calcule_lambda_et: PI tuning calculated (Lambda and SIMC) and saved.
cs.reglage_pi_theorique_du_modele: theoretical PI tuning of the model {0}, τc = {1:G6} s
cs.reglage_refuse_les_donnees_ne: TUNING REFUSED: the data do not allow it
cs.regle_simc_des_procedes_integrateurs_: SIMC rule for integrating processes (Skogestad 2003); nominal loop margins only.
cs.renseignez_la_commande_manuelle_et: Fill in the manual control and a switch instant between the start and the end of the scenario.
cs.renseignez_le_motif_et_la: Fill in the reason and the evidence reference.
cs.renseignez_toutes_les_valeurs_demande: Fill in all the requested values (strictly positive numbers).
cs.repere_grandeur_reglee_point_de: Tag, controlled quantity, operating point, objective
cs.reponse_de_la_mesure_trop: Measurement response too small compared with its tolerance.
cs.reponse_du_modele_a_un: Model response to a step, without controller
cs.reponse_la_plus_rapide_admise: Fastest response allowed by the usual design range: less margin, to be reserved for a well-established model.
cs.reponse_observee_et_modele_essai: Observed response and model – validation test
cs.reponse_observee_et_modele_essai_2: Observed response and model – estimation test
cs.reponse_plus_rapide_que_le: Response faster than the delay: significant overshoot, see the reservations.
cs.residus_autocorreles_sur_lessai_desti: Autocorrelated residuals on the estimation test.
cs.resultat_attendu_et_tolerance_fixee: Expected result and tolerance fixed before the test:

Theoretical result: actuator limits and speed, derivative filter of the real block and behaviour on the installation not assessed. Qualification on the installation required.
cs.resultats_theoriques_sur_le_modele: Theoretical results on the identified model: to be qualified on the installation. ORIAS never writes to the PLC.
cs.retard_nul_ou_mal_resolu: Delay zero or poorly resolved by the measurements. Refine the delay identification or choose Custom if the study imposes a target.
cs.retrouvez_les_essais_dans_identificat: Find the tests in “Identification” with “Search for usable tests”.
cs.revenir_a_l_horizon_complet: Back to the full horizon of the chart (double-click or Home)
cs.revenir_a_la_comparaison_pi: Back to the closed-loop PI comparison

cs.saisissez_la_cible_definie_pour: Enter the target defined for this study, in seconds.
cs.saisissez_les_sept_valeurs_numeriques: Enter the seven numeric values of the scenario.
cs.saisissez_les_six_valeurs_numeriques: Enter the six numeric values of the scenario.

cs.schneider_et_siemens_compatibilites_e: Schneider and Siemens, compatibilities and sources
cs.second_pole_non_superieur_au: second pole not greater than the delay: half rule, then PI.
cs.second_pole_superieur_au_retard: second pole greater than the delay: a PID is justified (SIMC rule); the derivative is filtered (Tf = Td/10 by default, usual range 2 to 20) and this filter is part of the judged loop.
cs.segment_s_enregistre_s_mesures: {0} segment(s) saved, {1:N0} samples, {2} missed in {3} gap(s), none interpolated.
cs.selection_lignes_originales_dont_affi: Selection: {0} original rows (of which {1} displayed) · [{2:G6} s – {3:G6} s]. Confirm to use this range in the next identification.

cs.selectionnez_les_colonnes_le_role_2: Select the columns, the role and the unit.
cs.selectionnez_un_import_et_trois: Select an import and three distinct columns (time, control output, measurement) to view the signals.
cs.selectionnez_un_projet_dans_la: Select a project in the list.
cs.selectionnez_une_etude_fopdt_et: Select a FOPDT study and give a strictly positive response time in seconds.
cs.selectionnez_une_plage_qui_montre: Select a range that shows the control before and after a single level change. If the control is already at the new level at the first sample, use a recording that starts before the change. Also check the stability of both plateaus within the declared tolerance.

cs.sensibilites_locales_trop_proches_pou: Local sensitivities too close to separate the parameters.
cs.seul_un_modele_accepte_a: Only a model accepted at the validation can be followed.
cs.simc_skogestad_2003_pour_explorer: SIMC, Skogestad (2003) · To explore a fast response, τc = delay. ORIAS keeps the cautious bound {0:G5} s: the control output step took place between two measurements, the real delay lies between {1:G5} and {2:G5} s. Check the obtained time and the control effort in simulation.
cs.simulation_en_boucle_fermee_enregistr: Closed-loop simulation saved on the identified model.
cs.simulation_exploratoire_sur_modele_no: Exploratory simulation on the nominal model.

cs.statut_initial_essai_a_realiser: Initial status: test to be carried out

cs.survolez_un_graphique_pour_lire: Hover a chart to read the values at the cursor.

cs.verifiez_les_valeurs_et_les: Check the values and units of the scenario.
